sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Daily Stock Analysis is an AI system that analyses a watchlist of stocks every day and pushes a decision dashboard to WeChat Work, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack or email. It covers China A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese stocks and ETFs.
sixtySeconds.problem: Tracking many stocks means reading prices, charts, news and filings every day. This project gathers that data, has a language model summarise each stock with a score, trend, levels and risks, and sends the report automatically. It can run free on GitHub Actions.
whoFor: Developers who want automated daily market reports
Chinese-speaking users (main README is Chinese; English docs exist)
People who prefer self-hosted tools to paid services
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a free, automated daily stock report you control. The project states it is for learning and research only, not investment advice.
requirements: At least one LLM API key (Gemini, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible and others) or Ollama locally
A GitHub account for the Actions option

overview: Each run produces an AI decision report per stock: a core conclusion, score, trend, buy and sell levels, risk alerts, catalysts and a checklist. Data comes from free sources like AkShare, Baostock and YFinance by default, with optional paid sources for stability, and news from search APIs such as SerpAPI, Tavily or Brave.

The recommended setup is GitHub Actions: fork the repo, add secrets for your model key, notification channel and STOCK_LIST, then enable Actions. By default it runs on weekdays at 18:00 Beijing time and skips non-trading days. You can also run it locally, in Docker, or as a FastAPI service.

A local web UI at 127.0.0.1:8000 offers manual analysis, history, backtesting, holdings and settings, and an agent mode answers follow-up questions using 15 built-in strategies. Free data sources can be rate-limited or change without notice.

steps.title: Add secrets
steps.body: Settings, then Secrets and variables, then Actions. Add an LLM key (for example GEMINI_API_KEY), a notification secret (for example TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID) and STOCK_LIST, such as 600519,hk00700,AAPL.

steps.title: Enable Actions and test
steps.body: Open the Actions tab, enable workflows, then run the daily stock analysis workflow manually.

steps.title: Clone and install
steps.body: On Windows use a short path such as C:\dsa.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis.git && cd daily_stock_analysis
pip install -r requirements.txt

environment.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environment.description: One of several supported LLM keys; at least one is needed.

environment.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environment.description: With TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, sends reports to Telegram; at least one channel is needed.

tutorial.title: Get a daily stock report on Telegram with GitHub Actions

setup: A Telegram bot token and chat ID

troubleshooting.problem: Windows install fails with long-path errors
troubleshooting.solution: Clone into a short path such as C:\dsa; see docs/FAQ.md.

troubleshooting.problem: Logs say a data source is not configured
troubleshooting.solution: That's fine; free sources are used by default.

troubleshooting.problem: Workflow didn't run on a holiday
troubleshooting.solution: Non-trading days are skipped by default.
